edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: High Note outranges your poke and Beat Drop chains a slow into damage before you can close.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: High Note keeps poking, and Beat Drop punishes any step you take toward her.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Full kit online: E blocks High Note and Beat Drop, and your stun windows finally close the gap.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: Late Seraphine out-scales you: her AoE Q, W shields, and wide Encore charm outvalue single-target peel.

edits.before: - Seraphine Beat Drop (Root): matchup-defining — Roots the already-slowed — dodge it and the song never builds. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Unbreakable banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Seraphine's Beat Drop (E) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s CD — root the already-slowed and the song never builds. - Your Unbreakable (E) is 16/14/12/10/8s — bank it for her Encore (R), 160/140/120s CD. - Ult is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Four stacks between you and your carry's autos triggers the stun — land the fourth as she opens Beat Drop.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Beat Drop (E) is only 11s CD early — walling reactively after it's spent trades engage for nothing.
